dataset: Tatoeba Japanese-English sentence packs, ordered by everyday commonness

source.name: Tatoeba.org
source.license: Sentences CC BY 2.0 FR (some CC0); attribution required

ranking.order: rank 1 = most everyday/common; all translations of the same Japanese sentence share a rank
ranking.freq_score: mean zipf word frequency of content words (wordfreq 'ja' data: Twitter/subtitles/web; UniDic lemmas via fugashi) minus 0.05 per token length penalty; higher = more everyday
